_comment: Copy to fleet.json on every machine that shares the display, identical on each.
Without this file the script posts its own stats alone, exactly as a single-machine install does.
'name' must match `hostname -s`. 'ssh' is how the master reaches that host;
the master's own entry needs none. 'cmd' defaults to ~/trmnl-claude/run.sh.
takeover_after_min: how long the master may go quiet before a secondary posts instead.
stale_after_min: how old a host's numbers may get before it stops counting as reporting.
